measurement.diagnostic: CPU4 same-input adjacent AB/BA, 80 one-checkpoint/eight-tick blocks; count capture+forward first writes+restore+resimulation. Initial 200-block c1 exceeded the 540-second wrapper limit. Instrumented c2 advanced through block 60 at about 3.76 seconds per checkpoint pair and was explicitly terminated because the unchanged batch would again exceed that fixed limit. Preserve both incomplete runs; reduce batch size only, retaining every oracle and pair in the new 80-block runs.
measurement.release: Serial A/B/B/A on both headed desktop peers at CPU4, independent Page-clock continuous 120Hz joystick, D0/H8, relay39 +/-5ms; preserve adverse runs
measurement.acceptance: Claim stage-specific measured improvement only when candidate beats repeated controls; no global FPS or rAF-freeze promise from copy counts alone
